data.one_liner: Flutterwave's official library that wraps the standard payment implementation.
data.what_it_does: Wraps the standard Flutterwave payment modal to collect payments in mobile apps. Supports collections, recurring payments, and split payments.
use_when: You need to integrate Flutterwave standard payments into your Flutter mobile app.
You want to process collections like cards, mobile money, and bank transfers using Flutterwave.
avoid_when: You are building a web application (only Android and iOS are documented platforms).
You require a payment gateway other than Flutterwave.
strengths: Official Flutter library provided by Flutterwave.
Supports multiple payment options including cards, mobile money, bank transfers, and USSD.
weaknesses: Limited platform support (documented for Android and iOS only).
Requires manual transaction verification on the backend or via API.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting the NDK version >= 27.0.12077973 on Android in android/app/build.gradle.kts and obtaining Flutterwave API keys.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are using Stripe instead of Flutterwave as your payment gateway.

alternatives.name: adyen_checkout
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer Adyen for payment processing.

data.minimal_example:
final Customer customer = Customer(name: "Flutterwave Developer", phoneNumber: "1234566677777", email: "customer@customer.com");
final Flutterwave flutterwave = Flutterwave(
    publicKey: "Public Key-here",
    currency: "currency-here",
    redirectUrl: "add-your-redirect-url-here",
    txRef: "add-your-unique-reference-here",
    amount: "3000",
    customer: customer,
    paymentOptions: "ussd, card, bank transfer",
    customization: Customization(title: "My Payment"),
    isTestMode: true );
final ChargeResponse response = await flutterwave.charge(context);
